name: consensus_wo_decide-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 6000; exit $s
